articles.summary: DALLAS (September 3, 2026) — AECOM (NYSE:ACM), the trusted global infrastructure leader, today announced its selection by the Santa Clara Valley Water District (Valley Water) to provide professional design services for the Pure Water Silicon Valley Demonstration Facility Project in California. articles.title: AECOM selected to design Pure Water Silicon Valley demonstration facility
